summary: OCR-parsed invoice dates causing ledger period mismatch and AP payrun hold
description:
Issue summary: Several vendor invoices scanned via the Vendor Portal OCR pipeline were parsed with incorrect invoice dates, which resulted in a mismatch between the invoice date and the accounting ledger posting period. Impact: Three invoices (Vendor: Acme Safety Supplies) were auto-flagged for ledger period mismatch and placed on AP hold, preventing them from being included in the scheduled payrun on 2026-03-12. Financial impact: estimated ~$23,400 in outstanding payments delayed; risk of late fees.

Observed behavior: OCR returned invoice_date values outside the expected accounting period (e.g., parsed as 2025-12-01 when the invoice header shows 01/12/2026), causing the AP validation rule to block GL posting. Expected behavior: OCR should parse dates in vendor locale or normalize to ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) consistent with AP rules, or flag ambiguous formats for manual review.

Environment: Production OCR pipeline for scanned/vendor-portal uploads; region: us-east; affected module: invoice ingestion -> ocr-service -> ap-validate-runbook.

Steps to reproduce: 1) Upload sample invoice.pdf from Acme Safety Supplies (attached). 2) Observe OCR output (attached ocr_raw.json) and parsed invoice_date field. 3) Run AP validation; see thrown validation error: "ledger_period_mismatch" and AP hold is applied.

Attachments: sample_invoice_Acme_001.pdf, ocr_raw_Acme_001.json, AP_validation_log_2026-03-11.txt.

Notes: This is not a one-off scanned-stapled-batch; pattern appears linked to ambiguous date formats (DD/MM/YY vs MM/DD/YY) and locale detection falling back to US parsing for some EU vendor templates.
steps_to_reproduce: Upload provided invoice PDF via vendor portal
Inspect OCR raw output for invoice_date field
Trigger AP validation job and observe ledger_period_mismatch error
observed_behavior: OCR parsed 01/12/26 as 2025-12-01 for one file and 2026-01-12 for others depending on template
AP validation applied ledger_period_mismatch and moved invoices to hold
Three invoices excluded from 2026-03-12 payrun in us-east cluster
expected_behavior: Dates normalized to ISO and validated against the invoice header
Ambiguous dates flagged for manual review instead of silently parsed
Invoices pass AP validation when header and parsed date align
impact: Potential vendor relationship impact and late fee exposure
Operational overhead: manual review required for blocked invoices

03/11 12:45 - Eng (OCR): locale detector returned "en-US" for template_v2 despite EU-format dates in samples; likely heuristics fallback problem
03/12 08:30 - Correlated with recent OCR model upgrade (ocr-service v2.7.1) deployed 2026-02-28; regression suspected
03/12 11:00 - Runbook lookup: see Confluence 'Invoice Date Validation Runbook' for temporary manual steps
comments: Support (Riley Chen) 2026-03-10: Received from FinanceOps. Uploaded artifacts to ticket. Marked P2 due to multiple invoices and payrun window.

FinanceOps (Lena Hoffmann) 2026-03-11: One invoice manually posted after confirming header date; two still blocked. Requesting engineering investigation and a short-term automation to flag ambiguous dates ahead of validation.

Eng OCR (Diego Morales) 2026-03-11: Reproduced locally with sample PDF. Locale detector uses heuristics based on vendor name and page layout; some Acme templates are new and not covered. Filing PR to add vendor-template override map. See PR: github.com/redwood/ocr-service/pull/432
Eng Platform (Diego Morales) 2026-03-12: Deployed temporary validation change: ambiguous dates now trigger "manual-review" flag instead of auto-parsing. Will monitor for false positives.
FinanceOps (Lena Hoffmann) 2026-03-12: Confirmed temporary change allowed two invoices to be moved to manual queue; team reconciled and scheduled payments. Please prioritize permanent fix.
Support (Riley Chen) 2026-03-13: Updated ticket with logs and listing of affected invoice IDs. Next steps agreed: PR review, patch release, and a follow-up check on next payrun.
resolution_notes: Workaround (applied 2026-03-12): Changed AP validation behavior so that ambiguous date parses are flagged for manual review instead of being used for ledger period assignment.
Short-term fix (in progress): Add vendor-template overrides and strengthen locale detection heuristics in ocr-service (PR 432/438).

Long-term remediation: Update OCR model parsing to emit date_confidence and canonical_date fields, add automated reconciliation job that cross-checks header date vs parsed date and surfaces mismatches in the AP console.
Follow-up items: 1) Postmortem to run after fix deploy and next payrun (owner: FinanceOps). 2) Add a monitoring alert for invoice_date confidence < 0.65 (owner: Observability).
resolution_status: Fix in progress - temporary mitigation applied
